comparison.objective: Track an unpredictably moving figure with a camera and react to a lamp; candidate commissions a mechanical damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous long-bar tracking plus cross-arm cue response versus fine tool insertion, rotary adjustment, counterholding, and bounded tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Keep target framed and press a remote button within 1 s versus two acceptable physical carriage stops and no setting drift. Framing tolerance is missing.
comparison.reason: Visuomotor tracking and cue response are unrelated to damper adjustment.
